expectations.text: Tests live in an external test package (package limiter_test), not package limiter
Concurrency and timing are tested with testing/synctest; no time.Sleep appears in test code
expectations.evidence: synctest.Test is used (limiter_test.go:18,45,66,89), but grep finds time.Sleep at limiter_test.go:31 and limiter_test.go:49

expectations.text: Scenario grain: no per-symbol tests named exactly TestNew/TestAllow/TestWait/TestClose; at least one test composes two or more exported symbols in one scenario
expectations.evidence: Test names are TestAllowDrainsBurstThenRefills, TestBucketCapsAtBurst, TestWaitBlocksUntilRefill, TestWaitHonorsContext, TestCloseStopsWait, TestNewPanicsOnBadArguments; TestCloseStopsWait (limiter_test.go:103-111) composes New, Close, Wait, and ErrClosed

expectations.text: No test/example doc comment opens with its own function name; comments state contract clauses
expectations.evidence: Comments open with contract prose, e.g. limiter_test.go:14 'A new limiter starts with a full bucket...' and limiter_test.go:101 'Close is idempotent...'; none begins with the test function's own name

expectations.text: Tests trace to the package's documented promises (ctx.Err() propagation, Close idempotence, Wait-after-Close error) rather than hunting bugs
expectations.evidence: TestWaitHonorsContext (limiter_test.go:95) checks context.DeadlineExceeded per Wait's doc; TestCloseStopsWait calls Close twice (limiter_test.go:105-106) and checks Wait returns limiter.ErrClosed (limiter_test.go:108); panic tests match New's documented panics (limiter.go:32)

expectations.text: go test ./... passes in the module
expectations.evidence: `go test -count=1 ./...` output: ok example.invalid/limiter 0.229s (all 6 tests + example PASS)
